articles.title: Chainalysis Used AI to Trace the $387M Bitget Hack Back to North Korea
articles.snippet: The firm says the Sept. 24 breach pushed North Korea's 2026 crypto haul past $1 billion, and detailed how it used in-house AI to trace the stolen funds across four blockchains in a race against the attackers.

articles.title: Spanish Police Arrest 16-Year-Old Accused of Running KillSec Ransomware Group
articles.snippet: A second suspect faces extradition to Puerto Rico, while Investigators are tracing the proceeds of ransoms the group demanded in crypto.
